title: Rule to Allow Crypto in 401(k)s Arrives at White House for Final Review
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Rule to Allow Crypto in 401(k)s Arrives at White House for Final Review A final Labor Department rule that would create a fiduciary safe harbor for private equity, real estate and crypto in 401(k) menus arrived at OIRA on Thursday, putting public release within reach. This post Rule to Allow Crypto in 401(k)s Arrives at White House for Final Review first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
